summary.text: Bobbie Harder is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 17B since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and former Sibley County commissioner, she was born in Le Sueur, Minnesota.

paragraphs.text: Bobbie Harder was born in Le Sueur, Minnesota, and earned a B.S. from South Dakota State University.
Her career experience includes working as a farmer.
She has served on the Sibley County Commission and has been affiliated with the Henderson Lions Club, Leading Sibley Together and the Minnesota Farm Bureau.
Harder took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on January 3, 2023, succeeding Dave Baker in District 17B.
The Republican primary for her seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
